text:
Main aapko yakeen dilata hoon ki aisi confusion dobara nahi hogi. Aapke refund ka confirmation 24 ghante ke andar mil jayega aur 5–7 business dinon mein amount aapke account mein aa jayega. 

Aapse baat karne ke liye shukriya, aur agar koi aur madad chahiye ho toh zaroor batayiyega. Aapka din shubh ho!
